items.title: Flatness of a module on a ringed site is equivalent to the vanishing of Tor-1 against every module

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the standard Tor-criterion for flatness on a ringed site (statement lines 3359-3369). The forward direction is the author's one-line consequence of exactness and the vanishing of satellites (proof lines 3372-3373). The converse is the real content: given an injection G -> H with cokernel Q, one must use the long exact sequence of Tor to identify the kernel of F tensor G -> F tensor H as a quotient of Tor_1^O(F, Q), so the hypothesis kills it and tensorisation by F is seen to be exact (proof lines 3373-3381). The point is the exact-sequence bookkeeping that converts the vanishing for the cokernel into exactness at G, which is what makes the criterion usable. The claim is H2: one standard exact-sequence argument after an immediate first direction.
